publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("Hong Kong, July 1st", by Christopher Patten (guest writer, governor of Hong Kong)), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.

entries.quote: a “bloody mess” when Hong Kong was returned to China (in 1997)
entries.subject: Hong Kong handover
entries.note: Restated in "Looking back on the future" (The World in 2006), a review by an outside historian; the original wording is not seen.

notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article. A guest article by the last British governor; it states hopes and regrets, not The Economist's predictions.
